posts.body:
Do you like trades? I like trades. I got picks, I got players.

Let's get the trade machine up and running!

:-P

Writing down for posterity:

- $50 bounty for recruitment
- raise weekly winner to $20
- $1 per game over .500 all-play

If you have proposals for next year put them under this topic.

The final cuts are due next Tuesday at noon. I'd recommend getting them in early so you don't forget. I put a countdown on the home page as an extra reminder.
- you need to decide how long all your contracts will be for newly signed players and rookies
- you need to get your roster down to 25
- rookies can be dropped with no penalty before the deadline
- dropping someone you haven't assigned a contract length to will assume it's a 1 year contract

Blind bid waivers will also process Wed. night at 11pm (this will happen every Wed. night during the season). After waivers process you can sign any free agents for $1 until noon Sunday (assuming they haven't had their game yet).

NOTE: You are responsible for understanding how this works. If you're not sure about something, post the question here and we'll try to clarify.

All these things are also on the league calendar. http://www53.myfantasyleague.com/2019/options?L=48571&O=123&MONTH=8&YEAR=2019.
